patch.value: Read the stored budget setting only when no explicit budget is given

An invalid stored case output_budget (0, -1, 1.5, 8193) threw before an explicit --budget was honored, because the eager integer(policy?.output_budget, 1600) fallback evaluated first. Read the stored setting lazily, only when no explicit budget transport is provided.
An explicit valid budget succeeds while the stored setting is invalid; Without a budget the invalid stored setting still refuses; Regression fails on revert

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Plan: apply the lazy stored-setting fallback in the command dispatch (requested budget first, stored section only when no explicit transport), search for other eager stored-setting fallbacks, and add an extension-harness contract that writes an invalid stored output_budget with the SDK settings writer and proves an explicit budget still succeeds while the un-budgeted command still refuses.
